description: This file implements the 'Delete' feature for comments in the Conduit application, including the command definition, validation, and the handler responsible for deleting a comment associated with an article identified by a slug.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the slug in the delete command is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of a comment given its ID and associated article slug, including error handling if the article or comment is not found.

methods.name: CommandValidator.CommandValidator
methods.description: Constructor that sets up validation rules for the command.

methods.name: QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the logic to locate and delete the comment associated with the provided slug and ID, throwing not found exceptions if necessary.
